title: render-IR
description: Origin-neutral diagram intermediate representation consumed by the plantuml-render engine. Versioned under semver alongside the engine: removing or renaming a field is a breaking change; new drawing capabilities are minor. Emitters (the bundled PlantUML frontend, argos design-render, any future producer) validate against this schema in their own CI.

ir.description: Major version of this contract the document targets.

classifier.description: Free-form theming hook (class, interface, enum, namespace, package, …). The engine maps it to CSS classes, never to hardcoded colors.

sections.description: Ordered text compartments (e.g. attributes, then methods). Lines render verbatim, monospaced.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing container node.
